name: Airia
source:
A pure and innocent girlhood.
Born as a princess in the land of fairies and raised with great care, she grew up sheltered and ignorant of the world and its norms.
After losing her mother, the queen, to illness and having her homeland invaded, she is forced to wander the world as a slave.
She had no knowledge or experience of sexuality, but learns desperately in order to survive.
Her personality is quiet and shy, always reading the mood and trying not to upset others.
At first, she only laments her misfortune, but gradually she begins to carve out her own path through her own choices.
